description: Canonical session-level ground-truth schema for the LLM-generated ecommerce benchmark.

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Primary join key back to events.parquet.

columns.name: anon_user_id
columns.description: Synthetic anonymous user identifier.

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Dashboard site identifier.

columns.name: persona_id
columns.description: Ground-truth persona id. Must never be fed into clustering features.

columns.name: ground_truth_label
columns.description: Human-readable canonical ground-truth label for reporting and evaluation.

columns.name: split
columns.description: Benchmark partition such as benchmark, eval, or stress.

columns.name: difficulty
columns.description: Scenario difficulty such as easy, medium, hard.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.description: Generator scenario or persona-card variant id.

columns.name: device
columns.description: Context variable used during generation.

columns.name: traffic_source
columns.description: Context variable used during generation.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Merchandise category used in the session scenario.

columns.name: promotion_exposed
columns.description: Whether a promotion/banner/coupon exposure was part of the context.

columns.name: new_user
columns.description: Whether the synthetic user is a first-time visitor.

columns.name: logged_in
columns.description: Whether the synthetic user is already authenticated.

columns.name: error_injected
columns.description: Whether the scenario includes an explicit friction or error condition.

columns.name: checkout_entered
columns.description: Session-level ground-truth outcome.

columns.name: purchase_completed
columns.description: Session-level ground-truth outcome.

columns.name: event_count
columns.description: Raw event count after generation and validation.

columns.name: expected_behavior_summary
columns.description: Short human-readable explanation of the intended behavior pattern.

columns.name: generator_model
columns.description: LLM model id used for generation.

columns.name: prompt_version
columns.description: Prompt or persona-card version used for generation.

columns.name: generator_version
columns.description: Synthetic generator implementation version.

columns.name: seed
columns.description: Deterministic generation seed.
